title: 17072 - 17072/P0688/001672
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
symptoms: Engine Coolant Fan running at full Speed while Ignition is OFF and Engine is COLD (could lead to discharged Battery)
commonCauses:
Power Supply Relay for Engine Control Module (J271) faulty
Terminal 87 faulty/hanging
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri between Engine Control Module (J220) and Power Supply Relay for Engine Control Module (J271) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Power Supply Relay for Engine Control Module (J271)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri between Engine Control Module (J220) and Power Supply Relay for Engine Control Module (J271)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Engine Control Module (J220)
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: a 2005 through 2007 2.5L NAR (North American Region) (1K) Jetta Kontrol edin: the T121/62 (Red/Black) traced power wire to the ECM.  If power is missing or a voltage drop is present that wire may be damaged anywhere between 6" and 18" from the connector itself. This will result in no communication in addition to a no-start.
Based on 2.5L Jetta feedback over the years a majority look like this example however some are damaged further away per this example: with the close-up and distant views.
